title: Christine Lakin Signed 8x10 Photo Framed Al Lambert Step by Step 1996 Autograph
descriptionText:
Christine Lakin - "Al Lambert" on the ABC/CBS sitcom Step by Step - hand-signed color 8x10 photo, signed in black marker across the lower portion of the image. The print is a celebritysightings.com fan photo (site watermark at the bottom edge). Displayed under glass in a slim black frame with an easel back, about 10 x 12 inches overall.

Obtained in 1996. No COA - please judge the signature from the close-up photos.

Condition: Photo is clean and bright under glass; the signature is bold with no fading. Frame shows only light handling wear. Sold as pictured - please review all photos, they are of the actual item you will receive.
